package.title: A Rumor Doubles Every 15 Minutes. When Does Everyone Know?
alt_titles: How Fast Does A Rumor Reach Everyone?
description: One person tells a secret. Every 15 minutes, everyone who knows tells one more person, so the number who know doubles.
2³³ = 8.6 billion, more than everyone on Earth (8.3 billion), after 33 rounds: 8 hours 15 minutes. Start at midnight and the whole planet knows by breakfast. That's exponential growth.
package.question: Which round surprised you? 👇
package.pinned: Real rumors slow down once most people already know (that's the logistic curve), but the first 30 rounds are pure doubling 📈
package.tiktok: One rumor, doubling every 15 minutes. How long until all 8.3 billion people know? #math #exponential #science
